summary: Summoning order after closure report; summons under Section 204 Cr.PC not mechanical; Magistrate must apply subjective satisfaction for sufficient grounds; summons to face trial for abetment of suicide under Section 306 IPC quashed due to inadequate application of mind on sufficiency of evidence; High Court's quashing under Section 482 Cr.PC upheld; existence of power vs exercise of power distinction; standard: prima facie evidence constituting offence; summons issuance requires scrutiny beyond complaint allegations.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's quashing of summons order sustained.
